description: This file is a shell script primarily responsible for managing device telemetry operations. It handles configuration loading, process control, scheduling cron jobs, remote command execution via SSH, telemetry data collection and processing, and interaction with system components for telemetry-related tasks in a device management environment.

methods.name: getEstbMac
methods.description: Retrieves the device's MAC address, either via dmcli or interface inspection depending on device type.

methods.name: getErouterIpv4
methods.description: Obtains the IPv4 address assigned to erouter0 interface.

methods.name: getErouterIpv6
methods.description: Obtains the IPv6 address assigned to erouter0 interface.

methods.name: getControllerId
methods.description: Collects SNMP data to retrieve controller and VCT IDs from local SNMP agents.

methods.name: getRFStatus
methods.description: Retrieves RF status metrics such as power levels and SNR via SNMP.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Processes the JSON response from DCM, normalizing and extracting telemetry configuration.

methods.name: scheduleCron
methods.description: Sets up or updates the cron schedule for telemetry data collection based on configuration.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Restarts the dropbear SSH server if it's not running, to facilitate SSH-based remote commands.

methods.name: clearTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Clears telemetry configuration and marker files to reset device telemetry state.

methods.name: generateTelemetryConfig
methods.description: Generates telemetry configuration files based on profiles and response data, preparing for data collection.

methods.name: sshCmdOnArm
methods.description: Executes a command via SSH on the ARM device, with retries.

methods.name: pidCleanup
methods.description: Removes the PID file to conclude the script's execution safely.
